subject.title: fix(tailscale): reset serve entries before setup to prevent duplicates on restart

question: Should Serve-mode startup ever run an unscoped `tailscale serve reset` by default, or must cleanup be limited to OpenClaw-owned or named-Service Serve state?
rationale: The bug fix needs cleanup before reapplying Serve, but broad reset changes existing operator-managed Tailscale state and cannot be resolved safely as a purely mechanical patch choice.

options.title: Require scoped cleanup
options.body: Keep startup cleanup limited to OpenClaw-owned or named-Service state and reject default broad reset unless a separate operator policy is approved.

options.title: Accept broad reset
options.body: Allow default no-service startup to clear all Serve routes, but require docs, tests, and live upgrade proof that make the operator impact explicit.

options.title: Consolidate on another PR
options.body: Pause this branch if a sibling PR becomes the proof-positive canonical implementation for the same issue.

recommendation.title: Require scoped cleanup
recommendation.body: Keep startup cleanup limited to OpenClaw-owned or named-Service state and reject default broad reset unless a separate operator policy is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the most recent current-file carry-forward and historical Tailscale runtime work in the affected gateway surface.
